title: Combination Sum (Unlimited Reuse)

monster.name: Sum Titan
monster.title: Pounder of Target Coin Allocations
monster.defeatQuote: Unbounded candidate reuse achieved the target sum!

description: Given an array of distinct integers `candidates` and a target integer `target`, return a list of all unique combinations of `candidates` where the chosen numbers sum to `target`. The same number may be chosen unlimited times.
starterCode:
def combinationSum(candidates: list[int], target: int) -> list[list[int]]:
    pass
solutionCode:
def combinationSum(candidates: list[int], target: int) -> list[list[int]]:
    candidates.sort()
    res = []
    def backtrack(idx, rem, path):
        if rem == 0:
            res.append(list(path))
            return
        for i in range(idx, len(candidates)):
            if candidates[i] > rem: break
            path.append(candidates[i])
            backtrack(i, rem - candidates[i], path)
            path.pop()
    backtrack(0, target, [])
    return res
hints: Since candidates can be reused, recursive call passes i instead of i + 1.
